rows.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS n FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Closed' AND County IS NOT NULL AND School IS NOT NULL GROUP BY County), top AS (SELECT County FROM c WHERE n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM c)) SELECT School, ClosedDate FROM schools WHERE StatusType = 'Closed' AND School IS NOT NULL AND County IN (SELECT County FROM top) ORDER BY ClosedDate
rows.review: The final SELECT returns many rows where School and ClosedDate are NULL, which don't name any school. Add `AND School IS NOT NULL` (and arguably `AND ClosedDate IS NOT NULL`) to the outer WHERE clause, and consider doing the same in the count CTE so the per-county totals reflect only named closed schools.

rows.sql: SELECT f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS' AND s.City = 'Fremont' AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015';

SELECT s.City FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.EILCode = 'HS' AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Lunch Provision 2' AND f."Low Grade" = '9' AND f."High Grade" = '12' AND f."County Name" = 'Merced';
SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS num_schools FROM schools s WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-8' AND s.Magnet = 1 GROUP BY s.City ORDER BY num_schools DESC, s.City
SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_customers FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A3 = 'north Bohemia' AND d.A11 > 8000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'
SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id FROM card c JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03'
SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_amount FROM card c JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21'
SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region FROM loan l JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE l.loan_id = 4990

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS account_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND t.balance < 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 1 AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';
SELECT c.client_id FROM "order" o JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = o.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id WHERE o.order_id = 32423
SELECT client_id, birth_date, CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year FROM client WHERE client_id = 130;

WITH f AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, d.A11
  FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
o AS (SELECT * FROM f WHERE birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM f)),
s AS (SELECT * FROM o WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM o))
SELECT DISTINCT di.account_id
FROM s JOIN disp di ON di.client_id = s.client_id;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m2 ON a.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id WHERE m2.label = '+') AS avg_single_bonds FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(a.element = 'c') / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = '=');
SELECT COUNT(*) AS triple_bond_count FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#';
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id WHERE b.bond_type = '=' ORDER BY a.element
SELECT CAST(SUM(b.bond_type = '#') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.bond_id) AS percent FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT atom_id, element FROM atom WHERE atom_id IN ('TR144_8', 'TR144_19');
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR124';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS count FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'n';
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = '=' LIMIT 50;
SELECT name FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL LIMIT 50

WITH rc AS (
  SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
  FROM cards c
  JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
  GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
)
SELECT name, artist,
       CASE WHEN isPromo = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_promo
FROM rc
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM rc)
SELECT type FROM cards WHERE name = 'Benalish Knight' LIMIT 50
SELECT manaCost FROM cards WHERE layout = 'normal' AND frameVersion = '2003' AND borderColor = 'black' AND availability = 'mtgo,paper'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isOnlineOnly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(id) AS percentage FROM cards WHERE frameEffects = 'legendary'
SELECT s.code, s.name, s.block, s.baseSetSize, t.language FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations t ON t.setCode = s.code WHERE s.block = 'Ravnica' AND s.baseSetSize = 180
SELECT language FROM foreign_data WHERE multiverseid = 149934
SELECT s.name FROM sets s JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code WHERE st.language = 'Russian' ORDER BY s.baseSetSize DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT fd.language FROM foreign_data fd JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
rows.review: The query returns duplicate language names because "Ancestor's Chosen" has several printings, and each printing's foreign_data rows are joined in. Add DISTINCT to list each language once: `SELECT DISTINCT fd.language FROM foreign_data fd JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL`.

rows.sql: SELECT s.releaseDate FROM sets s JOIN set_translations t ON t.setCode = s.code WHERE t.translation = 'Ola de frío';
SELECT s.type FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE c.name = 'Samite Pilgrim';

WITH t AS (SELECT frameEffects, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND frameEffects IS NOT NULL GROUP BY frameEffects) SELECT frameEffects, cnt FROM t WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM t);
SELECT uuid FROM legalities WHERE format = 'oldschool' AND LOWER(status) IN ('banned', 'restricted');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE UpVotes > 100 AND DownVotes > 1;
